Nice friendly bar with many regulars
Sep 2019
Nice bar/restaurant run by an Austrian/Vietnamese couple who likes to engage with their customers and are ever so nice. Food is good and a variety of local and more international dishes but you really come for the atmosphere and just to enjoy. 
If you are into playing pool there are a couple of good tables and I believe the Saigon pool association may be coming there from time to time. The place is big so the pool tables far from dominate the place and you can easily find a cosy corner away from the pool.
Frequently there is music there - the international schools in the naborhood provides for a lot of talent.
If in or close to District 2 definitely worth a visit.

Pleasant Surprise at Evita's
Dec 2018 • Friends
We tried Cafe Evita just for a change, as it is close to home, it looked nice and full when we passed, so not being fond of empty venues we popped in with friends. The place is homely, the staff were welcoming and friendly and they were also very adaptable. Two friends had chili quesadillas which they said were lovely and hot and very tasty and I asked whether they could make chili con carne on a bed of rice, as this was not advertised on the menu. The waitress said smilingly that she would try her best to persuade the chef and she came back 2 or 3 minutes later and said no problem. The chili con carne was very tasty though I added freshly chopped chilis which worked well to increase the level of spiciness. This wasn't the fault of Evita's chef - I tend to need to add more spice to chili con carne wherever I eat it as I like the dish very spicy. Our other friend had the spaghetti bolognaise which he said was super tasty and that the spaghetti was not overcooked like many other places but firm as should be. We had a few portions of french fries too, which despite being thin and not normally holding their heat too well, arrived piping hot and were delicious. This place is a find.

Great Place, Poorly Managed
Mar 2018 • Couples
This place has so much potential but is so poorly managed I don't see how they are still in business. I 've been there a couple of times but tonight decided to find another place to hang for our future nights out.

While playing pool tonight my girlfriend and I were chased off of the table by management. Were we playing too long? No we were in the middle of our second game when they (the management) decided they wanted to play on the table we were playing on in spite of the fact there was a second empty table When they saw we were packing to go they said "You're leaving so early". My girlfriend said "yes you want the poolt table we're playing on". The manager asked why we didn't play on the back pool table. When she responded with "why didn't you play on the table that was empty?" the manager said the table we were on "was a better table". Paying customers apparently mean nothing to the people. As the saying goes "I'll take my money elsewhere".
